scenes.description: A hotel room with a made bed, desk, minibar shelf, bathroom amenities tray, and a housekeeping cart at the door.
A classroom with pupil desks, a teacher's desk, supply bins, a bookshelf, and a whiteboard ledge.
A café service counter with a pickup shelf, condiment station, and dish return bin.

scenes.name_ja: オフィスの執務スペース
scenes.description: A shared office with desks, a printer station, a supply cabinet, and a meeting-room table.

evidence.source_name: Task Atlas cross-context task proposals, round 2
evidence.scope: Proposed collection designs that place objects already in the atlas (YCB, Google Scanned Objects, AI2-THOR) in hotel housekeeping, classroom, café and restaurant service, and office contexts, generated with claude-opus-5-5.
evidence.limitations: This design-seed source supports proposed task-suitability provenance only. It does not establish physical feasibility, population frequency, robot execution, asset compatibility, or clinical or occupational suitability of any assistive or workplace procedure.
evidence.notes: Assistive-care tasks use surrogates for medication and never make clinical decisions; people involved are consenting adults.

templates.name_en: Fold a spread towel where it lies into a set display shape of a given size, with its decorative band showing on top
templates.name_ja: 広げたタオルをその場で決められた大きさの展示用の形にたたみ、飾り帯を上面に見せる

templates.name_en: Fold the loose end of a mounted toilet roll into a centred housekeeping point without taking the roll off its hanger
templates.name_ja: ホルダーに掛けたままのトイレットペーパーの端を、中央がとがった清掃済みの三角に折る

templates.name_en: Lift a full liner out of a room waste basket that stays in place and drop it into the trash bag on a housekeeping cart
templates.name_ja: 元の場所に置いたままのくず入れから中身の入った袋を取り出し、清掃カートのごみ袋に入れる

templates.name_en: Restock a vanity amenities tray to a standard card: return the part-used item to the cart and set each fresh item on its mark, labels out
templates.name_ja: 洗面台のアメニティトレイを基準カードどおりに補充する：使いかけの品をカートに戻し、新しい品をそれぞれの位置にラベルを正面にして置く

templates.name_en: Count a minibar against its par card, tick each consumed item on the charge slip, and only then restock the empty slots to par
templates.name_ja: ミニバーを定数カードと照合し、消費した品を精算伝票にチェックしてから、空いた位置を定数まで補充する

templates.name_en: Turn a guest room down for the night: close the blinds, light the bedside lamp, turn back one duvet corner, and set the slippers facing the bed
templates.name_ja: 客室を夜に向けて整える：ブラインドを閉め、ベッドサイドのランプを点け、掛け布団の角を一つ折り返し、スリッパをベッド向きに置く

templates.name_en: Strip a used bed into a soiled-linen bag, check the bare protector, and remake it with a fresh fitted sheet, re-covered duvet, and pillowcase to a measured standard
templates.name_ja: 使用済みのベッドのリネンを使用済み袋に入れ、マットレスパッドを確認し、新しいボックスシーツ・掛け布団カバー・枕カバーで決められた基準どおりに整える

templates.name_en: Take a guest's forgotten item from the room into a sealed lost-property bag with its room tag and file it in the dated tray of the lost-and-found cabinet
templates.name_ja: 客の忘れ物を部屋から遺失物袋に入れて封をし、部屋番号のタグを付けて、遺失物キャビネットの日付別トレイに収める

templates.name_en: Hand out exactly one worksheet and one capped marker to each desk the seating card marks as occupied, leave unmarked desks bare, and return the surplus
templates.name_ja: 座席カードで使用と示された机にだけワークシートとキャップ付きマーカーを1つずつ配り、印のない机は空のままにして、余りを戻す

templates.name_en: Collect every guarded pair of scissors from the desks into the class caddy blades down, and turn the check card to its all-returned side once the count matches
templates.name_ja: 机の上のカバー付きはさみを刃を下にしてすべてクラスの道具入れに回収し、数が合ったらチェックカードを「全部返却」面に返す

templates.name_en: Stand a closed book face-out in the reading-corner ledge slot whose colour label matches the book's sticker, cover toward the rug
templates.name_ja: 閉じた本を、表紙のシールと同じ色のラベルが付いた読書コーナーの棚の枠に、表紙を敷物側に向けて立てかける

templates.name_en: Set up a science demonstration tray from its equipment list: each listed item in its labelled well, the unlisted item left in the supply bin
templates.name_ja: 器具リストに従って理科の演示トレーを用意する:リストの器具をそれぞれのラベル付きのくぼみに入れ、リストにない物は備品箱に残す

templates.name_en: Assemble a takeaway order from its ticket: the listed food items in the carry bag, the ticket clipped to the bag, and the bag and lidded drink together on the pickup-shelf slot with the ticket's number
templates.name_ja: 注文票どおりに持ち帰り注文をそろえる:記載の食品を持ち帰り袋に入れ、注文票を袋に留め、袋とふた付きの飲み物を注文番号の受け取り棚の区画に並べる

templates.name_en: Restock a condiment station by standing a full squeeze bottle cap-down in its labelled well, label toward the customer side
templates.name_ja: 調味料ステーションに補充する:中身の入ったスクイズボトルを、ラベル付きの差し込み穴にキャップを下にして、ラベルを客側に向けて立てる

templates.name_en: Bus a vacated restaurant table into a bus tub, carry it to the dish-return station, and sort scraps, plates, bowls, cutlery, and napkins into their own returns before stowing the empty tub
templates.name_ja: 空いた飲食店のテーブルの食器をバスタブに下げ、下げ台まで運び、残飯・皿・ボウル・カトラリー・ナプキンをそれぞれの返却先に分けて、空のバスタブを片付ける

templates.name_en: Hand a filled drink to the seated customer at the seat number on the order ticket, releasing only after they grip it
templates.name_ja: 注文票の座席番号の席に座っている客に、中身の入った飲み物を手渡し、客が握ったのを確かめてから放す

templates.name_en: Post a flat card lying on a counter through the narrow slot of a closed return box
templates.name_ja: カウンターに平置きされたカードを、閉じた返却ボックスの細い投入口から入れる

templates.name_en: Stock a sealed consumable pack in the rack bay whose label matches it, front facing out
templates.name_ja: 未開封の消耗品パックを、ラベルが一致するラックの区画に正面を手前にして補充する

templates.name_en: Put a tagged item into the numbered cabinet pocket that matches its tag
templates.name_ja: タグ付きの物を、タグと同じ番号の収納ポケットに入れる

templates.name_en: Clear a shared desk to its clean-desk card by closing the laptop and stowing personal items in the desk locker
templates.name_ja: クリーンデスクのカードどおりに共有席を片付け、ノートPCを閉じて私物を机のロッカーにしまう

templates.name_en: Set out one place set per booked seat from a booking card and ready the whiteboard tools
templates.name_ja: 予約カードの人数に合わせて予約席ごとに1組ずつ配り、ホワイトボード用具を用意する

templates.name_en: Repack loaned equipment into the fitted cut-outs and pocket of its return case and zip it shut
templates.name_ja: 貸出機器を返却用ケースの専用の型とポケットに詰め直し、ファスナーを閉める

templates.name_en: Deliver internal mail from the pigeonhole to several named drop points by a delivery slip and return the empty tote
templates.name_ja: 配達票に従って社内便を仕分け棚から複数の届け先へ配り、空のトートを戻す

templates.name_en: Archive selected folders into a box in label order, close and label the box, and shelve it in another zone
templates.name_ja: 選んだフォルダをラベル順に箱へ詰め、閉じてラベルを貼り、別の場所の棚に収める

tasks.name_en: Fold the flat-spread bath towel where it lies on the bed foot into the hotel display tri-fold, grey band on top and facing the door
tasks.name_ja: ベッドの足元に広げたバスタオルを、その場でホテルの展示用三つ折りにたたみ、グレーの帯を上面・ドア側に向ける
instruction_variants: Fold the bath towel into the display tri-fold right there on the bed foot, grey band on top toward the door.
Do the towel display for the bed: thirds lengthwise, then in half, band showing.
ベッドの足元に広げてあるバスタオルを、その場で縦に三つ折りしてから半分に折り、グレーの帯が上でドア側を向くようにしてください。
tasks.notes: Goal: the clean bath towel, which starts spread flat on the bed-foot runner, ends folded into the display tri-fold (lengthwise in thirds, then in half) with its grey woven band on top and toward the room door, in the same place. Labelled atomic: one object and one shape change, done in place with no transport; the band orientation is part of the display shape. Cross-links: task_thor_r3_guest_bed_pillows_towel_lamp places an already-folded towel at a guest bed's foot and does not fold it; task_ycb_round5_table_cloth_fold_grid folds a table cloth along a marked crease grid on a dining table with no display orientation. This task adds a hotel display fold with a set finished size and a visible band. The GSO scan is a rigid folded towel, so the real towel is used for the fold.

tasks.name_en: Fold the loose end of the toilet roll on its hanger into the housekeeping point, tip centred and hanging 40 mm below the roll
tasks.name_ja: ホルダーに掛かったトイレットペーパーの端を、清掃済みの印の三角に折り、先端を中央にしてロールから40 mm下に垂らす
instruction_variants: Fold the toilet roll end into a point for the next guest.
Give the toilet paper the housekeeping point: two corners folded in, tip in the middle, hanging about four centimetres.
トイレットペーパーの端を三角に折って、先端が真ん中でロールから4センチほど垂れるようにしてください。
tasks.notes: Goal: the toilet roll stays on its hanger and its loose end is folded into the housekeeping point (both corners folded in to meet on the centre line) with the tip centred on the roll and hanging 40 mm below it, the mark that the bathroom has been serviced. Labelled atomic: one object, one shape change, done in place. The roll's place on the hanger is preserved and not counted. The en-suite is staged in scene_home_bathroom, whose sink ledge and vanity stand in for a guest bathroom. Cross-link: task_thor_r2_toilet_paper_replace_spent_roll replaces a spent core with a fresh roll; this task leaves the roll and only folds its end. THOR state mapping: THOR Toilet_Paper has only isUsedUp and no sheet geometry, so the folded end has no THOR state and is judged on the physical roll.

tasks.name_en: Lift the full liner out of the room's desk waste basket, carry it to the housekeeping cart at the door, and drop it into the cart's trash bag
tasks.name_ja: 客室のデスク横のくず入れから中身の入ったごみ袋を取り出し、ドア前の清掃カートまで運んでカートのごみ袋に入れる
instruction_variants: Empty the desk bin into the cart bag: pull the liner and drop it in the trash bag on the cart.
Take the desk basket's liner out to the cart and put it in the trash bag; leave the basket where it is.
デスク横のくず入れの袋を取り出して、ドア前の清掃カートのごみ袋に入れてください。くず入れは元の場所に置いたままにしてください。
tasks.notes: Goal: the desk waste basket is empty and still on its floor mark, and its full liner is inside the open trash bag on the housekeeping cart parked at the room door, about 3 m away. Labelled atomic: one item (the liner) moves along one uninterrupted pick-carry-drop sequence and the basket is not moved or transformed; the basket's emptiness is the result of that one motion. The liner is left open, not tied, because the cart bag is tied later at the end of the floor. Cross-links: task_gso_r1_waste_basket_replace_liner is a home workflow that also fits a fresh liner and returns the basket under the desk; task_thor_r2_garbage_bag_collect_bins_to_front_door empties two home wastebaskets into one bag, ties it, and sets it by the front door. This task differs in destination (a staff cart's trash bag), leaves liner refitting to a separate step, and runs under hotel workplace controls. The bin contents are declared surrogates with no sharps.

tasks.name_en: Restock the vanity amenities tray to the room standard card: used shampoo to the cart return bin, fresh shampoo left, conditioner centre, soap bar right, labels out
tasks.name_ja: 洗面台のアメニティトレイを客室基準カードどおりに補充する：使いかけのシャンプーはカートの回収箱へ、新しいシャンプーを左、コンディショナーを中央、石けんを右に置き、ラベルを正面に向ける
instruction_variants: Set up the amenities tray to the standard card: shampoo, conditioner, soap from left to right, labels out, and the old shampoo goes back to the cart.
Swap out the used shampoo and restock the tray the way the card shows it.
アメニティトレイを基準カードどおりに整えてください。使いかけのシャンプーはカートの回収箱に入れ、左から新しいシャンプー、コンディショナー、石けんの順に、ラベルを正面にして置いてください。
tasks.notes: Goal: the amenities tray on the vanity matches the room standard card: a sealed fresh shampoo bottle on the left mark and the sealed conditioner bottle on the centre mark, both upright with labels facing the room, the wrapped soap bar on the right mark, and the guest's part-used shampoo in the cart's amenity return bin. Labelled compound: four objects and six goal predicates at one vanity and the cart caddy staged beside it, in one sitting. The tray is gso_object_porcelain_tray, reused as the amenities tray; its place on the vanity is preserved. Cross-links: task_gso_r2_conditioner_stand_in_organizer stands the conditioner in a home vanity organiser compartment label-out without a card or replacement; task_gso_r2_cleanser_unbox_order_on_tray unboxes a cleanser and orders three home skincare items on a vanity tray. This task adds a staff standard card, the swap-out of a used bottle to a return bin, and a mixed bottle-and-bar layout. The soap is thor_object_soap_bar_1 wrapped in a paper band for the trial.

tasks.name_en: Count the minibar against its par card, tick the chips and water boxes on the charge slip, then restock the chips can and one water bottle to par
tasks.name_ja: ミニバーを定数カードと照合し、精算伝票のポテトチップスと水の欄にチェックを入れてから、チップス缶と水1本を定数まで補充する
instruction_variants: Check the minibar against the par card, tick what's been taken on the slip, then top it back up from the caddy.
Chips and one water are gone: mark them on the charge slip first, then put a fresh can and bottle in, chips label out.
ミニバーを定数カードと見比べて、なくなったチップスと水を精算伝票にチェックしてから、カートの補充品で定数に戻してください。チップス缶はラベルを正面に。
tasks.notes: Goal: the minibar shelf is back at par (chips can in slot A label out, water bottles in slots B and C), and the charge slip has ticks in exactly the chips-can and water-bottle boxes, with every other box left blank. Labelled compound: two restocked items and two slip marks in one sitting at the minibar with the cart caddy beside it; the only constraint is ordering (the count and ticks come before restocking so the slip records what the guest took). The marker starts and ends capped; the cap is removed and refitted during the task but is a preserved state, not a goal change. Cross-links: task_ycb_round5_chips_can presents the can's barcode to an inventory scanner on a supermarket shelf, and task_ycb_round1_chips_can opens it for serving; neither counts against a par card or records consumption. This task gives the chips can a hotel minibar par-and-charge context and reuses ycb_041_small_marker as the staff pen. The water bottles are further sealed items with no catalogued asset.

tasks.name_en: Give the room turn-down service: close the blinds to the sill, switch the bedside lamp on, turn back the duvet's door-side corner, and set the slide sandals on the bedside mat facing the bed
tasks.name_ja: 客室のターンダウンサービスを行う：ブラインドを窓台まで下ろし、ベッドサイドのランプを点け、掛け布団のドア側の角を折り返し、スリッパをベッド脇のマットにベッド向きにそろえる
instruction_variants: Turn the room down: blinds closed, bedside lamp on, duvet corner folded back on the door side, slippers on the mat.
Do turn-down for this room while the guest is at dinner.
ターンダウンをお願いします。ブラインドを閉めてベッドサイドのランプを点け、掛け布団のドア側の角を三角に折り返し、スリッパをマットの上にベッドに向けてそろえてください。
tasks.notes: Goal: the room is turned down for the evening: the blinds are lowered to the sill, the bedside lamp is on, the duvet's door-side top corner is folded back into a 45-degree triangle exposing the sheet, and both slide sandals stand side by side on the bedside mat with their openings toward the bed. Labelled compound: four objects and five goal changes in one room in one sitting with no stage checkpoint. The guest is out of the room. Cross-links: task_thor_r1_blinds_close lowers living-room blinds alone; task_thor_r3_morning_alarm_off_lamp_off_blinds_up is the reverse morning routine at home; task_thor_r3_guest_bed_pillows_towel_lamp readies a home guest bed with pillows, a folded towel, and the lamp on but has no turned-back corner or blinds; task_gso_r2_slide_sandal_on_bath_mat sets one sandal on a bath mat facing the shower. This task adds the hotel turn-down set, where the turned corner and the slippers facing the bed invite the guest in. THOR state mappings: blinds closed maps to Blinds isOpen, and the asset database suggests isOpen=true is the extended, window-covering configuration, which is unconfirmed (a planning condition and asset limitation); the lamp maps to DeskLamp isToggled=true, with Desk_Lamp_1 standing in for a bedside lamp; the turned corner has no THOR state (Bed only has isDirty). The second sandal is a further unit of the same product.

tasks.name_en: Strip the checked-out bed into the cart's soiled-linen bag, check the bare mattress protector, then remake it to the hotel standard with fresh fitted sheet, re-covered duvet, and pillowcase
tasks.name_ja: チェックアウト後のベッドのリネンを外してカートの使用済みリネン袋に入れ、むき出しのマットレスパッドを確認してから、新しいボックスシーツ・掛け布団カバー・枕カバーでホテル基準どおりに整える
instruction_variants: Strip the bed into the soiled bag, check the protector, then make it up fresh to standard.
Full bed change for this checkout: old linen to the cart, new sheet, cover, and pillowcase, made to the hotel standard.
チェックアウト後のベッドを交換してください。使用済みリネンはカートの袋へ入れ、マットレスパッドを確認してから、新しいシーツ・カバー・枕カバーで基準どおりにベッドメイクしてください。
tasks.notes: Goal: the bare mattress protector has been photographed before any fresh linen touches it, the three used linen items (fitted sheet, duvet cover, pillowcase) are in the soiled-linen bag on the cart at the door; the bed carries a fresh fitted sheet with all four corners seated; the duvet insert is inside a fresh, fastened cover spread with even side overhang and its top hem 250 mm from the headboard; the pillow is in a fresh pillowcase, centred at the head with the case opening away from the door. Labelled workflow: three stages with a checkpoint and two destinations. Stage 1 strips the bed and carries the used linen to the cart bag at the door; checkpoint: the bare mattress protector is inspected and photographed before any fresh linen touches it; stage 2 fetches the fresh set from the cart's clean shelf, a second trip to the door; stage 3 makes the bed to the standard. Cross-links: task_thor_r1_bed_make_with_pillow pulls an existing duvet flat and sets the pillow at a home bed's head with no linen change; task_thor_r3_guest_bed_pillows_towel_lamp readies a home guest bed without stripping. This task adds a full hotel linen change with a soiled/clean separation, a protector check, and a measured finish. THOR state mapping: Bed isDirty=true stands for the unmade, stripped-or-used bed and isDirty=false for made; THOR does not simulate bedding, so every linen predicate is judged physically. The protector stays on the mattress throughout and is preserved.

tasks.name_en: Return the watch a checked-out guest left in the bedside drawer to lost-and-found: photograph it in place, seal it in a lost-property bag, clip on the tag for this room, and file it in today's tray in the housekeeping office
tasks.name_ja: チェックアウトした客がベッドサイドの引き出しに忘れた腕時計を遺失物として届ける：その場で撮影し、遺失物袋に封をして入れ、この部屋の番号のタグを留め、清掃事務所の本日の遺失物トレイに収める
instruction_variants: Room 1204 left a watch in the bedside drawer. Photograph it, bag and tag it for 1204, and file it in today's lost-and-found tray.
Handle the forgotten watch as lost property: sealed bag, right room tag, into the office cabinet.
1204号室の客がベッドサイドの引き出しに腕時計を忘れています。その場で写真を撮ってから遺失物袋に入れて封をし、1204のタグを付けて、事務所の遺失物キャビネットの本日のトレイに入れてください。
tasks.notes: Goal: the guest's wristwatch has been photographed in the open drawer before it was touched, and it is inside a sealed lost-property bag carrying the tag for room 1204 (not the tags for 1206 or 1208), the bedside drawer is closed again, and the bag lies in today's tray inside the lost-and-found cabinet in the housekeeping office with the cabinet door closed. Labelled workflow: three stages and two destinations with checkpoints. Stage 1 in the room: open the drawer, photograph the watch in place before touching it (checkpoint), bag and seal it, and close the drawer. Stage 2 at the cart in the corridor: pick the 1204 tag from the rack of three and clip it to the bag (checkpoint: tag number read back against the room plate). Stage 3 in the office about 30 m down the corridor: open the cabinet, lay the bag in the tray marked with today's date among three dated trays, and close the door. Cross-link: task_thor_r3_watch_under_sofa_into_trinket_dish recovers the same watch from under a home sofa into a trinket dish for its owner; this task handles it as a checked-out guest's lost property with chain-of-custody steps. The watch is the owner's property in the story but a trial item in practice; no real guest valuables are used.

tasks.name_en: Hand out one worksheet and one capped marker to each of the four desks the seating card marks, leave the two unmarked desks bare, and return the two spare sheets and markers to the teacher's desk
tasks.name_ja: 座席カードで印の付いた4つの机にワークシートとキャップ付きマーカーを1つずつ配り、印のない2つの机は空のままにして、余ったシート2枚とマーカー2本を教卓に戻す
instruction_variants: Tomorrow only desks 1, 2, 4 and 6 are in use. Put one worksheet and one marker on each of those, leave 3 and 5 empty, and bring the spares back to my desk.
Set out the handouts from the seating card: one sheet and one capped marker per marked desk, nothing on the others.
座席カードで印のある机(1・2・4・6番)にワークシートとマーカーを1つずつ置き、3番と5番は空のままにして、余りは教卓に戻してください。
tasks.notes: Goal: each desk the seating card marks (1, 2, 4, 6) holds exactly one worksheet with one capped marker lying on it, desks 3 and 5 stay bare, and the two surplus sheets and two surplus markers are back in the teacher's tray and cup. The YCB large marker goes to desk 1; the other five markers are identical capped resources. Labelled workflow: four stages with a checkpoint after each (count supplies against the card at the teacher's desk; deliver row 1, desks 1-3, and photograph it; deliver row 2, desks 4-6, and photograph it; return the surplus and recount), and six destinations across the room. bare(desk) means no item on the desk top, checked from the row photograph; bare(desk_3) and bare(desk_5) already hold at the start and are not counted as goal changes; they stay in goal_state because the instruction requires them and putting an item on an unmarked desk is the error the seating card exists to prevent. The worksheets are printed on 300 gsm card stock so a single sheet can be separated from the stack without a suction tool; this is a setup choice for repeatable trials. The markers stay capped throughout (preserved condition). The classroom is empty; no children take part. Differs from task_ycb_round3_large_marker and task_ycb_round3_small_marker, which stage markers in a workshop organiser or for a single handover; here the marker is one of a counted set spread across desks by a seating card. First classroom task on the YCB large marker.

tasks.name_en: Collect the four guarded pairs of scissors from the pupil desks into the class scissors caddy blades down, count them, and turn the return card to its green all-returned side
tasks.name_ja: 机に置かれたカバー付きのはさみ4本を刃を下にしてクラスのはさみ立てに回収し、数を確かめてから返却カードを緑の「全部返却」面に返す
instruction_variants: Collect the scissors off desks 1 to 4 into the caddy, blades down, and flip the card to green once all four are back.
Scissors back in the caddy please: four pairs, points down, and check the count before you turn the card.
机1〜4のはさみを刃を下にしてはさみ立てに戻し、4本そろったことを確かめてから返却カードを緑の面にしてください。
tasks.notes: Goal: all four pairs of scissors stand blades-down in the class caddy, the caddy holds exactly four, and the return card shows its green all-returned side, which the card may only show when the count is four. Labelled compound: two object sets and a card change state in one sitting at one destination; the four desks are only pick-up points. The YCB scissors have pointed blades, so for the whole sequence their closed blades are covered by a snap-on rigid blade guard; the other three pairs are round-tip school scissors with the same guard, listed as one resource. closed and guard_fitted are preserved conditions, checked before and after. blades_down means the guarded blade tip points into the caddy well and the handle rings are above its rim. The card is turned only after the operator-visible count of four; a short count leaves it red, and the run then fails. The caddy is a fixed-well classroom scissors block; the atlas's GSO desk caddy (gso_object_markings_desk_caddy) is not used because its scan does not show well dimensions. Differs from task_gso_r4_desk_caddy_sort_pens_scissors_ruler_notes, which sorts one pair among pens in a home desk caddy without counting, from task_ycb_round1_scissors, which hands one pair to a person, and from task_rcad_r1_search_counter_drawers_once_scissors_to_left_bottom, which searches kitchen drawers; here the scissors are a counted class set returned at the end of a lesson. The classroom is empty; no children take part.

tasks.name_en: Stand the large closed picture book face-out in the green-labelled slot of the reading-corner book ledge, cover toward the rug
tasks.name_ja: 閉じた大判の絵本を、読書コーナーの本棚の緑ラベルの枠に表紙を敷物側に向けて立てかける
instruction_variants: Someone left the big picture book on the cushion. Put it back on the ledge in the green slot, cover facing out.
Reset the reading corner display: green-dot book, green slot, front cover showing.
クッションの上の大きな絵本を、本棚の緑ラベルの枠に表紙が見えるように立てかけてください。
tasks.notes: Goal: the book stands face-out in the green-labelled slot of the reading-corner ledge with its front cover toward the rug, where pupils choose books by the cover and the colour dot. Labelled atomic: one object and one goal change, the move from the floor cushion into the slot, with cover-forward as the pose of that placement; the book starts closed and stays closed (preserved condition), so it is not also transformed. The ledge is a face-out display shelf with a 6 cm deep lip and a back rail that holds a book leaning back 10-15 degrees; the blue and red slots already hold books and must not be disturbed (preserved). THOR state mapping: closed corresponds to Book isOpen=false. THOR has no state for face-out display or for which cover faces out, so in_slot and cover_facing are checked from photographs only; the Book_1 bounding box (about 0.43 x 0.33 m closed) is taken to be a large-format picture book, and the ledge slot is sized 46 cm wide to fit it. Differs from task_thor_r2_book_close_shelve_upright, which closes an open book and shelves it spine-out upright on a living-room bookshelf, and from task_gso_r1_bookends_four_books_upright, which stands books upright between bookends; here a closed book is displayed cover-out in a colour-coded slot. The classroom is empty; no children take part.

tasks.name_en: Set up the rolling-race demo tray from its list card: tennis ball, golf ball, timer display-up, and ruler each in its labelled well, with the baseball left in the supply bin
tasks.name_ja: 転がり競争の演示トレーをリストカードどおりに用意する:テニスボール、ゴルフボール、表示を上にしたタイマー、定規をそれぞれラベルのくぼみに入れ、野球ボールは備品箱に残す
instruction_variants: Get the rolling-race tray ready from the list card: both balls, the timer and the ruler in their spots. The baseball isn't on the list, so leave it.
Lay out the demo kit on the tray exactly as the card lists it, timer face up and not started.
リストカードどおりに転がり競争のトレーを準備してください。テニスボール、ゴルフボール、タイマー(表示を上に、操作しない)、定規をそれぞれの場所に。野球ボールは箱に残してください。
tasks.notes: Goal: the four items on the rolling-race list card sit in their labelled tray wells (tennis ball in ball well 1, golf ball in ball well 2, timer display-up in the timer well, ruler in the ruler groove), so a teacher can pick up the tray and run the demonstration. Labelled compound: four objects placed from one bin onto one tray in one sitting. The YCB baseball is in the bin as an unlisted item and must stay there; that is a preserved condition checked in the success criteria, not a goal change. The YCB timer is a small battery-powered digital timer; its buttons are not pressed at any point and its display must still read 00:00 afterwards (preserved), so no device state changes. The tray is a moulded plastic tray with labelled wells (two 70 mm ball cups, a timer recess, a ruler groove) so the balls cannot roll. Differs from task_ycb_round3_056_tennis_ball, which prepares a marked two-ball comparison set in a playroom, from task_ycb_round4_076_timer, which orients the timer in an alert zone on a kitchen counter, and from task_ycb_round5_056_tennis_ball, which drops the ball; here the objects are picked from a mixed bin against a written equipment list. The classroom is empty; no children take part.

tasks.name_en: Make up takeaway order 47 from its ticket: banana and bagged muffin in the carry bag, ticket clipped to the bag, and the bag and lidded cold drink side by side on pickup slot 47
tasks.name_ja: 注文票47番の持ち帰り注文をそろえる:バナナと袋入りマフィンを持ち帰り袋に入れ、注文票を袋に留め、袋とふた付きの冷たい飲み物を受け取り棚の47番に並べる
instruction_variants: Order 47 to go: banana and the blueberry muffin in a bag, clip the ticket on, and put it on slot 47 with the iced drink.
Bag up ticket 47 for pickup. Fruit on the bottom, muffin on top, drink stays out of the bag.
47番の持ち帰りをお願いします。バナナとマフィンを袋に入れて注文票を留め、冷たい飲み物と一緒に受け取り棚の47番に置いてください。
tasks.notes: Goal: the banana and the bagged muffin are in the carry bag, the order ticket is clipped to the bag's folded top, and the bag and the lidded drink stand side by side on the pickup-shelf slot labelled 47, so the customer can collect everything the ticket lists from one place. Labelled compound: four objects and six goal predicates at one counter in one sitting, with ordering constraints only (banana in before the muffin so the muffin does not crush it; ticket clipped before the bag moves). The drink stays out of the bag and upright; it is already lidded and sealed (preserved). The muffin is a foam surrogate in a paper pastry bag and the drink is 350 ml of cold water in a lidded cup, so nothing is actually sold or eaten; the banana is a whole unpeeled fruit handled as food, with gloves. Slots 46 and 48 hold other dummy orders and must not be disturbed (preserved). Differs from task_ctx_r1_checkout_bag_heavy_low_cupcakes_on_top, which packs a grocery bag by weight at a checkout, and from task_ycb_round4_banana, which hands a banana from a plate to a diner; here the banana is one line on a café order ticket assembled at a numbered pickup slot. First café-service task on the YCB banana.

tasks.name_en: Restock the café condiment station: stand the full mustard bottle cap-down in its empty labelled well between the ketchup and mayonnaise, label to the customer side
tasks.name_ja: カフェの調味料ステーションに補充する:中身の入ったマスタードを、ケチャップとマヨネーズの間の空いたラベル付きの穴に、キャップを下にしてラベルを客側に向けて立てる
instruction_variants: The mustard slot on the condiment station is empty. Put the new bottle in upside down, label facing out to the customers.
Restock mustard at the station: cap down in its holder, label out front.
調味料ステーションのマスタードの穴が空いています。新しいボトルをキャップを下にして、ラベルを客側に向けて差してください。
tasks.notes: Goal: the full mustard bottle stands cap-down in the station's mustard well with its printed label facing the customer edge, so customers find it by label and the mustard sits at the nozzle. Labelled atomic: one object and one placement; turning the bottle over and setting its label heading are the pose of that single placement, and the bottle's contents and cap are not changed (closed and full are preserved conditions). The well is a 60 mm ring holder whose rim takes the bottle's shoulder, so the flip cap hangs free and carries no load; this holder is a stand-in fixture, since the YCB mesh does not establish whether the bottle can stand on its cap. The ketchup and mayonnaise bottles in the neighbouring wells must not move (preserved). The bottle stays sealed; nothing is dispensed. Differs from task_restock_mustard_shelf and task_face_mustard_label, which shelve or face the bottle upright on a retail shelf, and from task_ctx_r1_go_back_tote_return_three_items_to_home_slots, which returns it to an aisle slot, from task_ycb_round5_mustard_bottle, which seats it upright in a spill-contained caddy slot at a restaurant table, and from task_mustard_l3_11, which audits a condiment station at closeout without placing anything; here the bottle is restocked inverted, cap down, into a café self-service condiment holder.

tasks.name_en: Bus table 4 after the guests leave: load the square dinner plate, cereal bowl, fork, spoon, and napkin into the bus tub, carry it to the dish-return station, scrape and rack the plate, rack the bowl upside down, drop the cutlery in the cylinder and the napkin in the bin, and stow the empty tub
tasks.name_ja: 客が帰ったあとの4番テーブルを下げる:角皿、シリアルボウル、フォーク、スプーン、ナプキンをバスタブに入れて下げ台まで運び、皿の残りをこそげてラックに立て、ボウルを伏せてラックに、カトラリーは筒に、ナプキンはごみ箱に入れ、空のバスタブを片付ける
instruction_variants: Table 4 has left. Bus it: everything into the tub, take it to the dish return, scrape the plate, rack the plate and bowl, cutlery in the cylinder, napkin in the bin, and put the tub back.
Clear four and sort it at the return station, then bring the empty tub back to the side station.
4番テーブルを下げてください。食器をバスタブに入れて下げ台に運び、皿の残りをこそげてから皿とボウルをラックに、カトラリーは筒、ナプキンはごみ箱へ。最後に空のバスタブを戻してください。
tasks.notes: Goal: table 4 is clear; at the dish-return station the square dinner plate is scraped and stands in the plate rack, the cereal bowl sits upside down in the bowl rack, the fork and spoon are in the cutlery cylinder, the crumbs are in the food-waste bin, and the napkin is in the general waste bin; the bus tub is back, empty, on the server side station. Labelled workflow: three stages at two locations 6 m apart, each with a checkpoint (load the tub at the table and photograph the cleared table; carry the tub to the return station on a route with a speed cap; sort into five destinations and photograph each, then return the empty tub). no_scraps_on(plate) means no crumb larger than 2 mm is visible on the plate in its rack photograph. The tub is empty at the start and at the end, and it stands on the side station both times; these two are not counted as goal changes, but they stay in goal_state because the instruction requires the tub back, and it is loaded, carried and emptied in between. The scraps are a dry bread-crumb surrogate and the dishes start clean, so no water or real food waste is handled. The plate and bowl are porcelain: the tub is lined with a rubber mat and holds them side by side, never stacked. The dish-return station stands at the kitchen pass within the same dining room. Differs from task_ycb_round3_plate, which clears one plate and separates its utensils at a home dining table, and from task_gso_r3_drying_rack_unload_bowl_plate_spoons, which unloads a home drying rack; here the same kinds of dishes are bussed across a restaurant floor and sorted at a commercial dish return.

tasks.name_en: Serve the ordered drink to the customer in seat 2 at table 4: hold the porcelain mug out handle-first and let go only once they grip it
tasks.name_ja: 4番テーブルの2番席の客に注文の飲み物を出す:磁器のマグを取っ手を客に向けて差し出し、客が握ってから放す
instruction_variants: The drink on the ticket is for seat 2 at table 4. Hand it to them, handle toward them, and let go when they've got it.
Serve table four, seat two, the iced coffee. Don't let go until they're holding it.
4番テーブル2番席のお客様にドリンクをお出ししてください。取っ手をお客様に向けて差し出し、しっかり握られてから放してください。
tasks.notes: Goal: the mug is in the hand of the customer in seat 2, the seat the order ticket names, and the robot no longer holds it. Labelled atomic: one object and one goal change, a single handover; the mug starts in the robot's grasp at the aisle end of the table, so there is no pick. The customer in seat 1 is also seated and reaches only if asked; serving them instead is the main failure. The handle is presented toward the recipient's hand within 30 degrees during the offer; that is a procedure pose, not an end state, because the customer takes the mug and may turn it. Both customers are briefed, consenting adult participants. The drink is 200 ml of cool water standing in for an iced coffee; no hot drink is served. The mug is the GSO porcelain mug; its handle is part of the scan. Differs from task_gso_r4_tumbler_water_handover_seated_person, which hands a tumbler of water to one person in a home armchair, and from task_ctx_r1_mug_water_over_bed_table_handle_to_dominant_hand, which sets a mug down in a resident's reach zone; here the robot picks the recipient between two seated customers from the ticket's seat number, in a public dining room.

tasks.name_en: Post the returned visitor badge through the slot of the reception badge-return box
tasks.name_ja: 返却された来客用入館カードを受付のカード返却ボックスの投入口に入れる
instruction_variants: A visitor has left their badge on the reception counter. Post it through the slot in the badge-return box.
Drop the returned visitor card into the badge box through its slot; don't open the box.
受付カウンターに置かれた来客用カードを、返却ボックスの投入口から中に入れてください。ボックスは開けないでください。
tasks.notes: Goal: the visitor badge is inside the locked badge-return box, having gone in through its slot, so reception can reissue it. Labelled atomic: one object, one goal predicate change (counter to inside the box) in one uninterrupted pick, turn edge-first, and post. The difficulty is lifting a 0.8 mm card that lies flat on a smooth counter and aligning its short edge with a 60 x 3 mm slot; the box stays closed throughout (preserved condition). The YCB blank credit card stands in for a plastic visitor badge of the same ID-1 size; it carries no chip, print, or payment function. Distinct from task_ycb_066_blank_credit_card (stores the card in an open clear box on a workshop bench), task_ycb_round2_066_blank_credit_card (slides it into a non-payment sleeve), and task_ycb_round5_066_blank_credit_card (hands it to a participant); here the card goes through a narrow slot into a closed box at an office reception desk, and nobody is handed anything.

tasks.name_en: Stock the sealed cyan 251 ink pack in the cyan bay of the printer-station supply rack, front panel facing out
tasks.name_ja: 未開封のシアン251インクパックを、プリンター置き場の消耗品ラックのシアン用の区画に正面を手前にして補充する
instruction_variants: The cyan ink came in. Stand the pack in the cyan slot of the supply rack by the printer, front facing out so people can read it.
Put the new cyan 251 pack away in its bay on the printer rack, label outward; leave it sealed.
届いたシアンのインク（251）を、プリンター横の消耗品ラックのシアンの区画に、正面が見えるように立てて入れてください。開封はしないでください。
tasks.notes: Goal: the sealed cyan 251 retail pack stands in the rack bay labelled CLI-251 C with its front panel facing out, so the next person who needs cyan finds it. Labelled atomic: one object moved once from the counter into its bay, with the facing set as part of the same placement, as in task_ctx_r1_brisk_case_pack_bottom_shelf_front_out; nothing is opened. The Fuel thumbnail (checked 2026-09-26) shows this GSO scan is the sealed Canon retail pack, a grey carton with a red hang card and a visible cartridge window, not a loose cartridge, and the task uses it as that pack. The bay is chosen by reading the bay label among four colour bays (black, cyan, magenta, yellow). Distinct from task_gso_r1_ink_cartridge_install_cyan, which unpacks the same cartridge at a home printer and seats it in the print head; here the pack stays sealed and goes into shared office stock, and no printer is touched.

tasks.name_en: Put the returned pool-car key set into the key-cabinet pocket whose number matches its tag
tasks.name_ja: 返却された社用車の鍵束を、タグの番号と同じ番号のキーボックスのポケットに入れる
instruction_variants: Someone dropped the pool-car keys in the return tray. Read the number on the tag and put them in that pocket of the key cabinet.
File the returned car keys in the numbered pocket that matches their tag; leave the other pockets alone.
返却トレーにある社用車の鍵束のタグの番号を読み、キーボックスの同じ番号のポケットに入れてください。
tasks.notes: Goal: the ringed key set is in pocket 3 of the open wall key cabinet, the pocket whose number matches the tag on the ring, so the next driver finds it by number. Labelled atomic: one object, one goal predicate change, in one pick-and-drop after reading the tag. The tag is a separate plastic fob threaded on the ring at setup; the YCB keys are not known to carry any tag, so it is a stand-in. The cabinet has six open-top fabric pockets, 1 to 6, at 1.3 m; pockets 2 and 5 already hold other key sets and stay put. The cabinet door is open from setup and stays open (preserved). Distinct from task_ycb_round1_keys, which stores the key set in a designated tray on a workshop bench, and task_ycb_round5_039_keys, which cases it for handover; here the destination is chosen by reading a number, among several pockets at shoulder height in an office. Unlike task_ctx_r2_blank_card_visitor_badge_post_into_return_box, also a return at the office entrance, the difficulty is choosing the right open pocket, not threading a narrow slot.

tasks.name_en: Clear the hot desk to the clean-desk card: laptop closed and headset and notepad with it in the under-desk locker, locker shut, desktop bare except the monitor and dock cable
tasks.name_ja: クリーンデスクのカードどおりにフリーアドレス席を片付ける：ノートPCを閉じ、ヘッドセットとメモ帳と一緒に机下のロッカーに入れて扉を閉め、机上はモニターとドックケーブルだけにする
instruction_variants: End of day on the hot desk: close the laptop, put it, the headset, and the notepad in the locker under the desk, shut the locker, and leave only the monitor and dock cable on top, as the card says.
Make desk 14 clean-desk compliant: everything personal into the pedestal locker, door shut.
クリーンデスクのルールに従って14番席を片付けてください。ノートPCを閉じ、ヘッドセットとメモ帳と一緒に机下のロッカーへ入れて扉を閉め、机の上にはモニターとドックケーブルだけを残してください。
tasks.notes: Goal: the laptop is closed, it and the headset and notepad are in the under-desk locker, the locker door is shut, and the desk top holds only the fixed monitor and its dock cable, which is what the clean-desk card on the desk asks for. Labelled compound: six goal predicates over three items and a locker, in one sitting at one desk with no route. The laptop is already shut down and the dock cable already unplugged from it at setup, so no power state changes; the locker is an unlocked pedestal locker with a hinged door, and locking it is out of scope. Distinct from task_thor_r1_desk_clear_for_night (a bedroom desk where the laptop stays on the desk and pens go in a mug), task_gso_r4_laptop_video_call_corner_stand_cable_lamp_off (sets the same laptop up at home rather than clearing it away), and task_gso_r2_headset_coil_tie_hang (hangs the same headset on a desk hook); here the office rule is that nothing personal stays on a shared desk, so everything goes into a closed locker.

tasks.name_en: Set the meeting room for the four people on the booking card: a notepad and pen at each booked seat, none at the others, and the capped marker and eraser on the whiteboard ledge
tasks.name_ja: 予約カードの4人分に会議室を準備する：予約席ごとにメモ帳とペンを置き、ほかの席には置かず、キャップをしたマーカーとイレーザーをホワイトボードの受け皿に置く
instruction_variants: The 2 pm booking is for four. Put a notepad and pen at seats 1 to 4, nothing at the other seats, and the marker, capped, and the eraser on the whiteboard ledge.
Set the room up for the booking card: four places, marker and eraser ready at the board.
予約カードは4名です。1〜4番の席にメモ帳とペンを1組ずつ置き、ほかの席には置かず、キャップをしたマーカーとイレーザーをホワイトボードの受け皿に置いてください。
tasks.notes: Goal: exactly the four seats the booking card names each have one notepad-and-pen set, the four unbooked seats have none, and the capped marker and the eraser lie on the whiteboard ledge. Labelled compound: several items in one room in one sitting; the booking card sets how many places, so the count is part of the goal. The caddy holds six sets, so two must stay behind; that is the part a fixed layout would miss. The YCB large marker stands in for the room's whiteboard marker and is not uncapped or used to write, so its ink type does not matter here. Distinct from the workshop marker tasks task_ycb_round3_large_marker (puts capped markers in a label-station organiser) and task_ycb_round1_large_marker (recaps it after labelling), and from task_rcad_r1_tidy_five_ycb_items_into_five_closed_homes (returns a stray marker to a drawer); here the marker is set out ready at a whiteboard as part of a meeting-room setup driven by a count on a card.

tasks.name_en: Repack the office loan kit at the home desk: capped USB drive and adapter in their foam cut-outs, cable coiled in the lid pocket, case zipped shut
tasks.name_ja: 自宅の机で会社の貸出キットを返却用に詰め直す：キャップをしたUSBメモリと変換アダプタをスポンジの型に入れ、ケーブルを巻いてふたのポケットに入れ、ケースのファスナーを閉める
instruction_variants: I have to give the IT loan kit back tomorrow. Put the capped USB stick and the HDMI adapter in their foam slots, coil the cable into the lid pocket, and zip the case.
Pack the loaner kit back the way IT gave it out, then zip it up.
明日会社に返す貸出キットを詰め直してください。キャップをしたUSBメモリとHDMIアダプタをスポンジの型に入れ、ケーブルは巻いてふたのポケットへ入れ、ケースのファスナーを閉めてください。
tasks.notes: Goal: the capped USB drive sits in the drive-shaped foam cut-out, the adapter in its own cut-out, the cable coiled in the lid's mesh pocket, and the loan case zipped shut, as IT issued it, ready to go back to the office. Labelled compound: three items into three fixed places and one closure, at one home desk in one sitting. Each cut-out fits only its own item, so the drive must be turned to its outline before it drops in. Nothing is plugged in: the cable and adapter lie loose and unconnected on the desk at the start. Distinct from task_gso_r2_drawer_organizer_sort_and_close, which keeps the same drive at home in a drawer compartment, and task_gso_r4_usb_drive_insert_laptop_port, which plugs it into a laptop; here it goes back into an employer's loan case, shaped for it, for return. Also unlike task_gso_r1_pencil_case_pack_and_stow, the case has form-fitted places rather than one open pouch.

tasks.name_en: Do the internal mail round: check the pigeonhole items against the delivery slip, drop the folder in desk 7's in-tray, set the portable drive on desk 12's mat, rack the magazine in the meeting room, and shelve the empty tote
tasks.name_ja: 社内便を配る：仕分け棚の品を配達票と照合し、書類フォルダを7番席の受け箱へ、ポータブルドライブを12番席のマットへ、雑誌を会議室のラックへ届け、空のトートを棚に戻す
instruction_variants: Do the morning post round: check the three things in the pigeonhole against the slip, then the folder to desk 7's in-tray, the portable drive onto desk 12's mat, and the magazine to the meeting-room rack. Bring the tote back.
Deliver today's internal mail by the slip and put the empty tote back on its shelf.
社内便を配ってください。仕分け棚の3点を配達票と照合してから、フォルダは7番席の受け箱、ポータブルドライブは12番席のマット、雑誌は会議室のラックへ。空のトートは棚に戻してください。
tasks.notes: Goal: each of the three items on the delivery slip is at its own recipient's drop point (folder in desk 7's in-tray, drive on desk 12's mat, magazine in the meeting-room rack), the pigeonhole is empty, and the empty tote is back on its shelf. Labelled workflow: five stages over four locations with checkpoints. Stage 1, mail pigeonholes by the printer station: check the three items against the slip and load them into the padded tote (checkpoint: count three). Stages 2 to 4: carry the tote to desk 7, desk 12, and the meeting room in that order and drop one item at each (checkpoint at each: the item matches the slip line for that stop). Stage 5: take the empty tote back to its shelf. The drive is shock-sensitive, so it rides in a foam-lined tote and is lowered onto the mat, not dropped. Distinct from task_gso_r3_portable_drive_pack_shipping_box, which packs the same drive for posting from home; from task_ycb_round4_075_magazine, which stands the magazine in a rack in a YCB storage scene; and from task_ctx_r1_slide_sandal_night_path_bed_to_toilet_cleared, which moves the magazine to clear a path at home. Here the drive and magazine are internal mail with named recipients across an office.

tasks.name_en: Archive the four 2025 quarter folders from the wire sorter into the storage box, Q1 at the front, close and label it, and shelve it on the archive shelf
tasks.name_ja: ワイヤーファイルスタンドの2025年四半期フォルダ4冊を保管箱にQ1を手前にして順に詰め、箱を閉じてラベルを貼り、書庫の棚に置く
instruction_variants: Archive last year: take the four 2025 quarter folders out of the wire sorter, pack them in the box Q1 to Q4 front to back, close it, stick the 2025 Projects label on the front, and put it on the archive shelf, label out. Leave the 2026 folder in the sorter.

tasks.notes: Goal: the four 2025 quarter folders are in the cardboard box in Q1-to-Q4 order from front to back, the box is closed with the 2025 Projects label on its front, it stands on the supply cabinet's archive shelf label-out, and the 2026 folder is still in the sorter. Labelled workflow: three stages in two zones with checkpoints. Stage 1, filing desk: pull only the 2025 folders from the sorter and pack them in quarter order (checkpoint: order read from the tabs before closing). Stage 2, filing desk: close the box and apply the label to the front. Stage 3, supply cabinet across the office: carry the box and shelve it label-out (checkpoint: label facing the aisle). THOR mapping: closed(thor_object_box_1) maps to Box isOpen false; the asset's open state has the same bounding box, so flap folding, folder order, and the label have no THOR state and are listed as planning conditions. Distinct from task_gso_r3_file_sorter_folders_tab_order, which files folders into the same sorter at home, and from task_thor_r2_box_pack_cd_cases_close_flaps, which packs CD cases into the same box at home; here the box becomes a labelled office archive, packed in a set order and shelved in another part of the office.

Workplace safety on every task: guest_room_vacant_no_guest_present, staff_kept_1_m_clear_of_arm_during_motion, and arm_speed_capped_0_25_m_s, each checked from room video and the controller log; tasks that use the corridor cart add corridor_cart_zone_coned_no_guests_within_2_m and base_speed_capped_0_5_m_s_in_corridor, checked from corridor video and the base-speed log. Declared loads: liner under 0.5 kg, duvet insert 1.8 kg, single carried load under 3 kg. Bin surrogates contain no sharps; the bedside lamp is a battery LED; all amenity bottles stay capped; 'used' linen is laundered linen set up as used; the watch is a trial item.

THOR state mappings: Bed isDirty true/false stands for unmade/made; Blinds isOpen for window covered is unconfirmed (planning condition and asset limitation); DeskLamp isToggled stands for the bedside lamp; Toilet_Paper has only isUsedUp, so the point fold has no THOR state; Watch_1 has no state.
